scope: Official FSS chronology used to map current Serbia territory through Yugoslav predecessor governance and the 2006 independent-state transition.
limitations: Historical lineage is structural context; predecessor-state results and scale are not automatically assigned to present-day Serbia.

observations.text_value: FSS treats the 1919 founding of the Yugoslav football association as the origin of today's Football Association of Serbia.
